pack.topic: Verifying Developer Track Record and Approvals in Coimbatore
pack.source_script_insight: Just as a traditional shawl is bestowed only upon individuals of verified honor and standing, a real estate developer's credibility must be verified through physical approvals and past project delivery before granting them your financial trust.
pack.coimbatore_angle: Focuses on Coimbatore land and property buyers performing due diligence by physically verifying DTCP/TNRERA approvals and past completed projects in Coimbatore neighborhoods rather than trusting unverified marketing claims.
pack.visual_strategy: The visual strategy uses close-up, high-definition physical evidence of credibility—such as official DTCP stamps, TNRERA online verification screens, physical parent deeds, and actual completed, occupied residential buildings in Coimbatore. The camera language is steady, observational, and grounded in reality, avoiding any generic CGI or empty land montages to emphasize rigorous verification.
pack.core_takeaway: Never invest based on promises; verify a developer's track record and official approvals first.

pack.gemini_video_prompt:
# MANDATORY OUTPUT FORMAT & REALISM LOCK
- Format: 10 seconds total, native portrait 9:16 vertical composition. Full-screen, no black bars, no sidebars.
- Style: Ultra-photorealistic, real-world physical footage. Absolutely no 3D architectural renders, no cartoon animations, no motion graphics templates, no plastic CGI surfaces, no fake skies.
- Setting: Authentic Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu environments. Natural sunlight, realistic shadows, subtle atmospheric haze, natural vegetation movement, and believable physical scales.

# SUBJECT & CONCEPT LOCK
- Subject: Developer Reputation and Due Diligence.
- Concept: Just as respect is earned and symbolized by traditional honors, a developer's credibility in Coimbatore must be verified through physical approvals (DTCP/TNRERA) and past project delivery before investing.
- Forbidden Default Story: Do not show an empty plot transforming into a house, or a happy family entering a new home. Every scene must focus on the physical evidence of verification and track record.

# EXACT 7-SHOT SEQUENCE (0.0 to 10.0 Seconds)

## Scene 1 (0.0s - 1.4s)
- Location: Indoor office desk, Coimbatore.
- Visual: Close-up, high-angle shot of a person's hand holding a physical, white paper DTCP approval document. The camera focuses on a crisp, blue ink official stamp on the paper. Natural daylight streams from the side, casting soft shadows.
- Camera: Static macro shot, shallow depth of field.
- Text Overlay: "நம்பகத்தன்மை முக்கியம்" (small, clean sans-serif font at the bottom).
- Voiceover (Tamil): "மதிப்புள்ள முதலீட்டிற்கு..."

## Scene 2 (1.4s - 2.8s)
- Location: Indoor setting.
- Visual: Eye-level close-up of a modern smartphone held in a hand. The screen displays the live TNRERA registration portal website, showing a project list with green checkmarks. A thumb gently scrolls down the screen.
- Camera: Static close-up, sharp focus on the phone screen with realistic reflections.
- Text Overlay: "TNRERA சரிபார்ப்பு"
- Voiceover (Tamil): "...அங்கீகாரம் தான் அடையாளம்."

## Scene 3 (2.8s - 4.2s)
- Location: Outdoor residential layout in Coimbatore.
- Visual: Low-angle shot of a solid, weathered concrete boundary stone planted firmly in the ground next to a clean asphalt road. Engraved survey numbers are clearly visible on the concrete surface. Green grass blades sway slightly in the background.
- Camera: Static low-angle shot, sharp textures on the concrete and road.
- Text Overlay: "உண்மைத்தன்மை"
- Voiceover (Tamil): "வெறும் விளம்பரங்களை நம்பாமல்..."

## Scene 4 (4.2s - 5.6s)
- Location: Office table.
- Visual: Close-up of hands carefully turning the aged, slightly yellowed pages of a physical parent deed (mother document). The paper texture and old ink writing are highly detailed under warm, natural light.
- Camera: Slow, subtle push-in, focusing on the movement of the paper.
- Text Overlay: "பத்திர சரிபார்ப்பு"
- Voiceover (Tamil): "...பத்திரங்களை நேரில் சரிபாருங்கள்."

## Scene 5 (5.6s - 7.0s)
- Location: Coimbatore suburban street.
- Visual: Smooth tracking shot taken from a moving car window, showing a modern, fully completed and occupied apartment building. Balconies have potted plants, clothes drying, and cars are parked neatly in the stilt parking area.
- Camera: Smooth, horizontal tracking shot, realistic motion blur on the foreground.
- Text Overlay: "முந்தைய திட்டங்கள்"
- Voiceover (Tamil): "முந்தைய திட்டங்களின் தரமே..."

## Scene 6 (7.0s - 8.5s)
- Location: Meeting room.
- Visual: Mid-shot focusing on a wooden table where a physical paper layout map is spread out. Two hands point to specific plots and road markings, discussing details. Only the hands and the map are in focus; the people remain secondary and out of focus.
- Camera: Static mid-shot, natural indoor lighting.
- Text Overlay: "நற்பெயர்"
- Voiceover (Tamil): "...அவர்களின் உண்மையான நற்பெயர்."

## Scene 7 (8.5s - 10.0s)
- Location: Premium completed layout in Coimbatore.
- Visual: Eye-level static shot looking down a perfectly paved, clean black tar road inside a completed layout. Modern streetlights line the road, and a clear, natural blue sky is visible above. No empty plot-to-house transition. A tiny, elegant "OliveTree Investors" logo appears at the top corner.
- Camera: Static wide shot, balanced exposure, realistic perspective.
- Text Overlay: "பாதுகாப்பான முதலீடு"
- Voiceover (Tamil): "OliveTree உடன் பாதுகாப்பாக முதலீடு செய்யுங்கள்!"

# MOTION-GRAPHICS & LOGO LIMITS
- No full-screen graphics, no animated characters, no cartoon transitions. Only clean, minimal, semi-transparent text overlays in white, placed in the lower third of the frame.

# NEGATIVE PROMPT / REMOVAL RULES
- Absolutely ban: 2D/3D animated explainers, architectural walkthrough renders, game-engine visuals, plastic-looking CGI, fake skylines, floating text, distorted hand shapes, duplicated people, camera crew reflections, religious symbols, fake landmarks, landscape framing with black sidebars.
pack.title_english: Coimbatore Property: How to Verify Developer Reputation
pack.caption_english: In real estate, credibility and trust aren't just given—they must be earned through verified track records. Before investing your hard-earned money in Coimbatore, look past glossy brochures. Verify the DTCP and TNRERA approvals, inspect the parent documents, and physically visit the developer's completed projects to check their quality. A developer's past delivery is their true badge of honor. Partner with OliveTree Investors to navigate your property journey with absolute safety and clarity. DM us to get our due diligence checklist today!
